Name: 19'S SEASONAL BUILDINGS
Author: 1919shijiu
Description:
Shijiu Seasonal Buildings

Hand-drawn seasonal retextures for farm buildings and structures: spring, summer, fall and winter, switching automatically with the season. Free to use.

Every object in the pack has four seasonal textures, drawn by hand. No configuration needed.

Included — CP version: 25 farm buildings and structures

Farmhouse (all levels) · Greenhouse · Silo · Mill · Well · Stable · Shed · Big Shed · Slime Hutch · Coop · Big Coop · Deluxe Coop · Barn · Big Barn · Deluxe Barn · Log Cabin · Plank Cabin · Stone Cabin · Fish Pond · Earth Obelisk · Water Obelisk · Desert Obelisk · Island Obelisk · Gold Clock · Junimo Hut

Included — AT version: 23 objects / 109 textures

Same list, except that the three cabin materials (log / plank / stone) are merged into one entry, and all farmhouse levels share a single appearance. Each still has its own four seasonal textures.

[b]Two versions — pick one[/b]

CP version ([CP] Shijiu Seasonal Buildings)
- Requirements: SMAPI + Content Patcher
- Textures apply automatically, nothing to configure
- Cabin materials match exactly (log / plank / stone)
- Gold Clock hands handled internally

AT version ([AT] Shijiu Seasonal Buildings)
- Requirements: SMAPI + Alternative Textures 7.0.0+
- Textures switch with the season automatically; to change a building's look, apply this pack's texture to it with the in-game paint bucket tool
- Cabin materials are picked randomly by the framework
- Gold Clock hands need the bundled [CP] Shijiu Gold Clock Hands Patch

[b]Requirements[/b]

- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI
- Content Patcher — CP version, and the Gold Clock patch
- Alternative Textures 7.0.0 or newer — AT version

[b]Installation[/b]

1. Delete any older version of this pack first.
2. Unzip and put the folder(s) into Stardew Valley/Mods/.
3. Install either the CP version or the AT version — not both.
4. AT version: the download contains two sibling folders, [AT] Shijiu Seasonal Buildings and [CP] Shijiu Gold Clock Hands Patch. Put both into Mods/, as siblings. Do not move the patch inside the AT folder — it would not be loaded. The patch needs Content Patcher; without it the AT version still works, the vanilla clock hands just stay visible.

[b]FAQ[/b]

Why do the barns and coops look the same at every tier?
Only one appearance was drawn for them: Barn, Big Barn and Deluxe Barn share one look, and so do the three coop tiers. This is by design, not a missing or misapplied texture. Every tier and every season was verified in both packages.

The Gold Clock still shows the vanilla hands (AT version).
The vanilla clock hands are not part of the building texture — the game draws them on top. Alternative Textures can only replace textures and cannot remove that animated layer. Install the bundled [CP] Shijiu Gold Clock Hands Patch next to the AT pack and they disappear.

The Community Center clock lost its hands too.
Expected. The Community Center clock and the Gold Clock share the same hand sprites, so a texture-only fix cannot target just one of them.

My cabins all show different materials (AT version).
Alternative Textures draws cabin materials from a random pool and cannot be forced. Use the CP version if you need exact per-material replacement.

My farmhouse looks the same at every level (AT version).
The AT farmhouse uses a single appearance shared by all four levels, by design. Each season still has its own texture.

My textures don't show up at all.
Building retexture packs overlap. Make sure only one pack replacing these buildings is installed at a time.

[b]Compatibility[/b]

- Install only one building retexture pack at a time.
- v3.0.0 changed how this mod coexists with other building packs. Older versions could make both packs fail to apply; this is fixed.
- If you have an older version of this pack, delete it before installing this one.
